$Comment: A Grave Candle, what the Gravekeeper burns to open the Headless Horseman's graveyard (Hallows_Eve_Graveyard.json's EntryCost; the hard ride takes a Burning Grave Candle, Hallows_Eve_Offer_Burning_Grave_Candle.json beside this file). Always on the stall: no purchase limit and no rotation, since every party's ride needs one. SortOrder 5 puts it first on the lanterns shelf, where a player sent here by Old Jack or the Gravekeeper looks first. Cost is the price in Hallow Sweets. Named by the item's own keys.
